genuine_zero_volume_zscore.condition: Current candle volume equals window mean (abs(v - mean) < 1e-9) and standard deviation > 0.

zero_variance_volume_zscore.condition: All candles in window have identical volume (std == 0.0). Division by zero prevented by fallback.

missing_or_nan_volume_zscore.condition: Volume is NaN, infinite, or missing. Evaluated as fillna(0.0).

clipped_volume_zscore.condition: Volume z-score exceeds [-5.0, 15.0] bounds and is clipped.

fail_closed_rules: Whenever fallback_applied == True, eligible_for_prospective_scoring MUST BE False.
Whenever feature_quality_status != PRISTINE, prediction is tagged EXCLUDED_FROM_EVALUATION.
Raw feature values are preserved numerically as defined by frozen CBE-0.8.0 bundle.
